title: Derived-unit and adjunction normalized constant-tower site transport
statement: With the ordinary constant-module transport and exact tower equivalence $C_T$ of [def-sf-integral-compactification-ordinary-site-transport], derive the termwise direct-image square on strict towers [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. The direct-image comparison is the unique natural isomorphism $\mathrm R f_*C_T\cong C_V\mathrm R f_*^{\rm model}$ whose composite with the universal derived unit agrees, on every cochain complex, with the termwise section-normalized comparison, using the exact-localization factorization $QC_T\cong C_T^{\rm Ch}Q$. Define directModel to be this unique comparison. Define pullModelMap as its adjunction mate for the published derived pullback/direct-image adjunctions; this mate is invertible, and pullModel is the resulting isomorphism. For an open immersion $j$ and a presentation of the adjunction between the fixed model extension-by-zero and pullback functors [lem-sf-constant-semilinear-generator-comparison], define openModelMap as the mate of pullModel inverse under the published open adjunctions. It too is invertible; openModel is its inverse-direction isomorphism. All comparisons use the exact small-site equivalences, their universal derived units, and the specified adjunctions, including empty opens.
